route_title: ZnS-MgF2 Alternating Dual-Band IR Filter on Daimon-20
compilation_rationale: Explicit 22-layer alternating ZnS/MgF2 stack defined on CaF2. Bounds 50-1000 nm applied to all coating layers. Targets cover both passbands and stopbands using mean transmittance constraints at normal unpolarized incidence. Coherent smatrix solver selected per request.
